P3.why_the_registration_was_wrong: THE THRESHOLD WAS SET ON A METRIC THAT COUNTS A CLASS OF ROW NO MEASURE CHANGE CAN MOVE.  Seven of the fifteen are uncertainty-insufficient-data lanes where the machine says CAP_RIDE and the hand says CONTENT.  Neither label is COPY_BACK, so neither voids anything; the disagreement exists because the machine's label set has five values and the reviewer was only ever asked 'copy or not'.  Those same seven rows are in wave 43's 23.  Registering 3 against a metric with a 7-row floor was a registration defect and it is recorded as one.

the_residual_error_has_ONE_mechanism_and.finding: ALL EIGHT void-changing errors are on lanes with NO PAYLOAD_ANCHORS ENTRY.  PAYLOAD_ANCHORS covers summarization-priorities, context-retrieval and debugging-off-by-one; a lane with no entry is measured against the concatenation of its user turns, which is the whole prompt INCLUDING the instruction text.
the_residual_error_has_ONE_mechanism_and.why_that_produces_both_error_directions: writing-concise-email UNDER-reads: seven held lanes the hand called copies land at union 0.461140 to 0.481865, because the copied material is the ask and the ask is only about half of the prompt.  uncertainty-insufficient-data OVER-reads: a response that echoes the instruction text scores against instruction text that is in the denominator, which is how 0.693333 happens on a lane that is not a copy of anything.
the_residual_error_has_ONE_mechanism_and.NOT_FIXED_THIS_WAVE_AND_WHY: adding a payload anchor for writing-concise-email would move seven classifications AFTER the measurement that revealed them, which is exactly what wave 42 refused to do and exactly what this wave's whole argument depends on not doing. The CL768 ladder is EIGHT rungs flat -- the body at 0.6644639834x and V12, V10, V9, V8, V7, V6, V5, all 1/15 across 0.2693 of ratio -- and K has never cost a case on this body in eight consecutive 1,024-row steps.
